Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_19548",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_enumerate_blob",
    "line":1263,"var":"new","code":"new = pgp_new_blob(card, blob, tag, sc_file_new()); pgp_set_blob(new, data, len)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Blob C1 is created from TLV-parsed card response with attacker-controlled data and length (21 bytes: algo_id + 20 OID bytes)"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_get_card_features",
    "line":884,"var":"blob","code":"pgp_get_blob(card, blob73, i, &blob) >= 0 && pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob(blob, &key_info) >= 0",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Blob C1 with attacker-controlled data is passed to pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob for parsing"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob",
    "line":725,"var":"j","code":"for (j=0; j < (blob->len-1); j++)",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Loop bound is blob->len-1 (=20) but oid.value is int[16]; no check that blob->len-1 <= SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob",
    "line":726,"var":"oid.value[j]","code":"oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1]",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"When j >= 16, writes past end of stack-allocated oid.value[16] array causing stack-buffer-overflow WRITE 4"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_enumerate_blob",
     "line":1263,"operands":["blob->data","blob->len"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob",
     "line":725,"operands":["j","SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"blob->len - 1","right":"SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob",
     "line":726,"operands":["oid.value[j]","blob->data[j+1]"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"j","right":"16"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_enumerate_blob",
       "line":1263,"operands":["blob->data","blob->len"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob",
       "line":725,"operands":["blob->len"]},
      "type":"data","via":["blob"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"blob->len","right":"21"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob",
       "line":725,"operands":["j","blob->len-1"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob",
       "line":726,"operands":["oid.value[j]"]},
      "type":"data","via":["j"],
      "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"j","right":"16"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
